data_boundary: The five confirmation singers are spent and may not be used to tune or select a replacement estimator.
diagnosis: The fixed adult target table and generic LPC pole selection transfer poorly across unseen sung voices, especially /i/ and /u/. Clean synthetic closure does not predict recorded-human closure.
next_valid_experiment: Develop speaker normalization or a more robust formant representation on a disjoint VocalSet development group, then freeze it before evaluating a still-untouched confirmation group.
claim_boundary: H4 remains open. This is a falsification on straight sung long tones, not ordinary speech, and no motor-learning claim is made.
